name: get_coupling_metrics
description: Return afferent coupling (Ca), efferent coupling (Ce), and instability score for a file/module. Ca = files that import this module (dependents). Ce = files this module imports (dependencies). Instability I = Ce/(Ca+Ce): 0 = stable, 1 = unstable. Use to identify fragile modules and guide refactoring priorities.

repo.description: Repository identifier (owner/repo or just repo name)
